links.note: 'Permanent forest estate' is the collective name for reserved AND protected forests. The item spans 23937 and 23938; I have put it on 23937 because that is the larger share (more than half of India's forest land) and the first-named of the pair. The distractor 'unclassed forest' (23939) is precisely what the term excludes.

Three of the four options are community-driven - Joint Forest Management, Beej Bachao Andolan, Chipko - and the odd one out, demarcating a wildlife sanctuary, is a state act. Chipko and Beej Bachao are 23941, villagers organising against felling and commercial pressure in their own forests. 23940 states that communities live in forests; this item is about their organised action.
